# ALU with 8 Operations

```bash
OPCODE:
  000 => AND
  001 => OR
  010 => NOT
  011 => XOR
  100 => ADD
  101 => SUB
  110 => LEFT SHIFT
  111 => RIGHT SHIFT
```
